app.title: Open Your Bible!
app.description: Read the Bible in the translation of your choice

help.intro: Type the book, the chapter and, if you like, the verses:
help.from: from verse 3 to the end of the chapter
help.combined: verses 3 to 12 and 21 to 38 (the dot separates the parts)
help.colon: a colon after the chapter; the parts are then separated by commas
help.dash: an en dash instead of the hyphen
help.name: the full name of the book
help.usfm: the USFM code of the book, the same in every translation
help.spacedName: books with a space in their name (like 1 Corinthians): only by abbreviation or USFM code
help.note: Upper or lower case makes no difference. The abbreviation of each book is shown in the book list.

helpPage.intro: What each button on the Bible screen does.

menu.title: Menu
menu.button: Opens the menu, with the Bible, this help and the About page.

translation.title: Translation and appearance
translation.language: Interface language. The translation list shows the Bibles in that language.
translation.bible: Bible translation. The last option, “Upload...”, opens a Bible file from your device.
translation.theme: Theme: automatic (follows the device), light or dark. Each tap switches to the next one.

upload.title: Bible upload
upload.intro: Shown when the chosen translation is “Upload...”.
upload.file: Chooses the Bible file: EBF (JSON), OSIS or USFX (XML).
upload.download: Downloads the loaded Bible, converted to the EBF format.
upload.help: Supported formats and where to find Bibles to download.

books.title: Books
books.list: Opens the list of books in the translation, with the abbreviation of each one. Tapping a book opens chapter 1.

reference.title: Reference
reference.field: Type the Bible reference: the passage appears as you type. The field turns red when the reference is wrong.
reference.search: Text search: looks for words in the Bible text, by relevance or in book order.
reference.history: History of opened references. Tapping one opens the passage again.
reference.help: How to type the reference (see also the end of this page).

formatting.title: Text formatting
formatting.intro: Each button turns a display option on or off; when lit, it is on. The choice is saved on the device and also applies to copied text.
formatting.quotes: Puts the passage in quotation marks.
formatting.verseNumbers: Shows the number of each verse.
formatting.lineBreaks: Starts each verse on a new line.
formatting.ellipsis: Shows [...] where the passage skips verses.
formatting.parenthesesReference: Shows the reference in parentheses after the text.
formatting.sectionTitles: Shows section titles, in translations that have them.

actions.title: Passage actions
actions.intro: When you scroll and these buttons leave the screen, a copy of them appears just below the text.
actions.copy: Copies the displayed text, with the chosen formatting.
actions.share: Shares the link to the passage. If the device can't share, the link is copied instead.
actions.crossReferences: Placed after verses that have cross-references (in some translations). Tapping it shows the related passages.

messages.cannotShareUpload: References from manually uploaded Bibles cannot be shared.

errors.noBibleLoaded: No Bible file has been loaded.
